title: Seasonal Perk
description: Schema for seasonal perk data in tarkov-data-overlay. Seasonal perks are the BSG "Seasonal Character" mechanic (EFT patch 1.1.0.0). tarkov.dev serves the pvp-season game mode but has no seasonal-perks endpoint, so they ship as an overlay addition keyed by the perk id.

id.description: BSG perk id (matches the object key).

type.description: Perk tier as reported by the client (e.g. "common", "personal").

name.description: Display name (from the client locale bundle).

description.description: Display description (from the client locale bundle).

points.description: Perk-point cost/refund; null when the perk carries no point value.

mutuallyExclusiveSeasonalPerkIds.description: Perk ids that cannot be selected alongside this one.

effects.description: Effects the perk grants or imposes.

itemFilter.description: Items/categories the effect applies to, matching tarkov.dev's served ItemFilters shape. Arrays of tarkov.dev ids: item template ids for items, item-category node ids for categories. Ids only - names resolve via tarkov.dev's locale system.
